requirement: The system shall prevent a pupil from being enrolled in a class whose year group does not match the pupil's current year group.
The system shall calculate a pupil's term attendance percentage from the number of sessions attended divided by the number of sessions timetabled.
The administrator enters a new pupil's details; the system validates that required fields are present, assigns a unique pupil reference and stores the record.
The teacher opens a class register; the system lists every pupil on roll and lets the teacher mark each as present, late or absent, then saves the register.
As a teacher, I want to record a behaviour incident against a pupil so that the pastoral team is informed and can follow up.
As a parent, I want to view my child's timetable and term dates so that I can plan family arrangements.
As a school administrator, I want to close the register for the day so that no further edits can be made after the deadline.
A pupil's record may only be edited by the form tutor assigned to their class, or by a member of the school office.
Every change to a pupil's attendance record must be written to an audit log with the original mark, the new mark, the user and the time.
The pupil table shall guarantee that each pupil has a unique reference and a year group within the range the school supports.

-- pupil master table for school administration
CREATE TABLE pupil (
    pupil_id       BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    pupil_ref      VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    given_name     VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    family_name    VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    date_of_birth  DATE         NOT NULL,
    year_group     SMALLINT     NOT NULL,
    status         VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    enrolled_on    DATE         NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pupil_ref_unique    UNIQUE (pupil_ref),
    CONSTRAINT pupil_year_range    CHECK (year_group BETWEEN 1 AND 13),
    CONSTRAINT pupil_status_chk    CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE','LEFT','EXCLUDED','SUSPENDED')),
    CONSTRAINT pupil_dob_not_future CHECK (date_of_birth <= CURRENT_DATE)
);

CREATE INDEX pupil_year_idx ON pupil (year_group, status);

-- class table linking pupils to a form group
CREATE TABLE school_class (
    class_id      BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    class_code    VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    year_group    SMALLINT     NOT NULL,
    form_tutor_id VARCHAR(40),
    capacity      INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT class_code_unique UNIQUE (class_code),
    CONSTRAINT class_capacity_positive CHECK (capacity > 0)
);
-- attendance register table
CREATE TABLE attendance_register (
    register_id    BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    class_id       BIGINT      NOT NULL,
    register_date  DATE        NOT NULL,
    pupil_id       BIGINT      NOT NULL,
    mark           VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    recorded_by    VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT reg_class_fk FOREIGN KEY (class_id) REFERENCES school_class(class_id),
    CONSTRAINT reg_pupil_fk FOREIGN KEY (pupil_id) REFERENCES pupil(pupil_id),
    CONSTRAINT reg_mark_chk CHECK (mark IN ('PRESENT','LATE','ABSENT','AUTHORISED'))
);

requirement: The school shall produce a daily absence report listing every pupil marked absent without authorisation, with their class and guardian contact.
